title: The Billionaire Who Bought the Patent to Every Unspoken Lie

why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme moral horror combined with actual financial engineering creates outrage and shock value.

why_this_can_go_viral: Weird, relatable, and dystopian — everyone sleeps, so the concept of selling that right feels universally creepy.
